messages:
ana: Quick question — should we expose rollout/pin metadata in the client SDK for better observability? thinking about fields like model_version, pin_source, cohort.
kevin: would help debuggability a lot. main worry: does that leak tenant or internal routing details? :thinking_face:
jamal: Threat model first — what are we afraid of? tenant leakage, attribution of requests to internal experiments, and accidental PII in freeform labels.
maria: Also worry about metrics cardinality. If clients log raw pin tags we could explode ingestion. Need sanitization and rate limits.
nana: ops-bot: FYI deploy to staging pushed with rollout-metadata v1 flag enabled.
luca: proposal: expose a strictly-typed, minimal view called "rollout_metadata_public" that the SDK can surface. it should be safe-by-default (no tenant ids, no freeform strings).
kevin: +1 for safe-by-default. Can we include a hashed reference to internal ids so ops can trace but external consumers can't reverse?
jamal: hashing helps. but remember hashes can be brute-forced if low entropy. use HMAC with per-tenant secret or KMS-derived salt.
maria: also add a telemetry-only field separate from SDK-exposed one. e.g. "telemetry_hint": {"cohort":"canary-a"} that gets removed from client responses but sent to our internal ingest.
nana: ops-bot: Note: telemetry pipeline already supports separate ingestion streams per tag.
luca: sample public schema I'm thinking of (safe, minimal):
```json
{
  "model_version": "string",        // human-friendly label like "rwd-v1"
  "variant": "string|null",        // canary/stable, small enum
  "expiry": "iso8601|null",        // soft expiry for client caches
  "anon_ref": "sha256:<hex>"      // HMAC'd opaque ref for ops correlation
}
```
kevin: love the anon_ref. ops should be able to map it -> deployment via internal table. important: never include raw tenant ids.
jamal: fallback behavior: if client sees unknown schema fields, it should ignore them. keep forward compatibility. add a minor version token in the metadata to help SDKs.
maria: runtime concerns: adding a tiny JSON blob to responses increases token count and latency marginally. prefer putting it in response headers for text endpoints. header vs body tradeoff?
luca: headers is neat for low-latency apps, but browsers limit header sizes and CORS adds complexity. we can make it configurable per route.
nana: ops-bot: Proposal approved to A/B expose rollout_metadata_public in staging for 10% of SDK traffic.
kevin: action items: 1) define exact field enums and validation; 2) implement HMAC salt per-tenant rotation plan; 3) SDK behavior on unknown versions; 4) telemetry-only pipeline tags.
jamal: I'll sketch RFC follow-up with threats, schema, and migration plan. will include sample queries to map anon_ref -> internal blob.
maria: also include ingestion rate limits and sampling guidance in the RFC.
luca: one more: allow tenants to opt-out of public exposure via account setting. default ON for PLG, OFF for enterprise.
nana: ops-bot: created issue RED-1234 to track RFC + implementation tasks.
kevin: cool. thanks all — ping me with the RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
